shots.motion: Pigeons take off from a gothic railway station building while commuters hurry past and a young woman walks against the crowd
A young woman pushes open a heavy wooden door, it creaks open slowly, dust drifts in the light
Ceiling fans turn slowly in a huge archive room, dust floats in light shafts, a young woman walks down the aisle between tall shelves
An old clerk turns an old ticket over in his fingers and raises an eyebrow, peering over his spectacles
An old finger slides down a handwritten ledger page and stops on one line, dust floats in the air
A young woman carefully unfolds a large brittle old newspaper at a long table under a green lamp
Slow push in on an old newspaper front page and its grainy photograph
Flames flicker and thick smoke billows from a burning train coach at night while silhouettes run on the platform, sepia film grain
An old man steps out of thick smoke from a burning train door cradling a crying baby, smoke swirls around him, sepia
An old man hands a baby to a railway porter, then turns and walks back into the smoke toward the fire, sepia
A tear forms in a young woman eye as her fingertip trembles on an old newspaper photo
A young woman leans in closer over an old newspaper, focus shifts to a small photo
Slow push in on an old newspaper caption under a grainy baby photo
A young woman stares in shock, frozen, as a ceiling fan slows to a stop behind her
A smartphone vibrates and lights up with an incoming call in a trembling hand
